sources.notes: Point-in-time expressions of each act, /akn/sz/act/<year>/<num>/eng@<date>. Each expression page is read from its latest Internet Archive capture (raw id_ form), never from EswatiniLII's own document pages; the capture timestamps and sha256s are pinned in sources.json. Request count covers the Internet Archive and EswatiniLII's open listing pages.

sources.name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine
sources.licence: Archived copies of EswatiniLII pages; the content licence is EswatiniLII's
sources.notes: CDX API for discovery, then https://web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<original url> for the page bytes.
